officialText:
Platform lifts, stairway chair lifts and VRCs shall be inspected and tested at intervals not exceeding one year. Inspections and tests shall be performed in accordance with Table N1.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
